home.heroTitle: Learn live, and track your progress step by step
home.heroSubtitle: Live online courses with lecture recordings, questions and feedback, and certificates for those who qualify, all in one place.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need in one place
home.f1Body: Join live lectures on Zoom, and come back to the recordings whenever you like.
home.f2Body: Answer lecture questions and see your grades and your instructor's comments.
home.f3Body: See your attendance, your results, and how close you are to a certificate.

login.title: Sign in

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Registration is free and gives you access to your courses and progress.
register.subtitleEnroll: Create your account and we will enroll you in the course automatically once you confirm your email.
register.phoneHint: Include the country code, for example +216 12 345 678

register.checkEmailBody: If we can create an account with this email, we have sent it a confirmation message. Open the link inside to finish signing up, and check your spam folder if you do not see it.

forgot.title: Reset your password

noAccess.title: You do not have access

course.newSubtitle: Start with the basics and finish the rest after it is created.
course.slugHint: Letters, numbers and hyphens, such as intro-to-fiqh. It cannot be changed after publishing.
course.slugLocked: The link cannot be changed once the course is published.
course.languageHint: A language code, such as ar or en.
course.prereqHint: Leave empty and it disappears from the public page.
course.coverHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

settings.title: Course settings
settings.partialWeightHint: From 0 to 1. A value of 1 counts partial attendance as full attendance.
settings.penaltyHint: Suggested when grading; you can change it for each answer.

revealModes.AFTER_GRADE_AND_DEADLINE: After grading and the student's deadline

status.title: Course status
status.publishHint: Once published, the course appears on the public pages and people can enroll.
status.unpublishBlocked: A course with enrolled students cannot be unpublished. You can archive it instead.
status.archiveHint: Enrolled students keep access, and no new students are accepted.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.notEnabled: Certificates are not enabled for this course. Enable them in the course details.
certificates.reqIntro: Turn a requirement off by disabling it. Every change creates a new version and flags earlier decisions for review again.
certificates.noVersion: No requirements have been set yet.
certificates.noConsent: Has not agreed to data sharing
certificates.reasonNeeded: This decision differs from the automatic result, so a reason is required.
certificates.exportIntro: Only approved students are exported, and only if they agreed to data sharing and do not need a new review. An export stores a snapshot of the numbers at the time it is created.
certificates.skipped: {count} approved student(s) were left out because they did not agree to data sharing.
certificates.personalData: The file contains personal data: share it with care.
certificates.pageMore: There are more: use the page links.

team.searchLabel: Find an account by name or email

team.noTeam: Nobody has a role specific to this course.

roles.ownerLocked: The owner always has every permission, and this role cannot be changed.
roles.studentNote: A student has no administrative permissions by design.
roles.cannotGrant: You do not hold this permission, so you cannot grant it.

keys.exam_reopen: Reopen the exam and grant attempts

audit.tzNote: Dates are in your time zone ({tz}).

course.title: Course report

course.noLectures: No lectures have been held yet.
course.distributionLabel: Number of students in each score band
course.certNote: Figures come from the stored decisions, which update whenever work is graded or the requirements change.

attendanceImport.title: Import attendance from a file
attendanceImport.intro: Upload a Zoom participants report (CSV), or any file with an email or name plus the time spent or a status. You see the matching result first, and nothing is saved until you confirm.
attendanceImport.fileHint: UTF-8, up to 1 MB. In Zoom: Reports → Usage → pick the meeting → Export.
attendanceImport.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.
attendanceImport.presentAt: Present if they stayed at least (% of the lecture)
attendanceImport.partialAt: Partial if they stayed at least (%)
attendanceImport.belowAbsent: Anything less is recorded as absent.
attendanceImport.absentMissing: Mark students who are not in the file as absent
attendanceImport.absentMissingHint: Not recommended: a student may have joined with a different email. Better to review them by hand.
attendanceImport.overwriteHint: By default the records you entered by hand are kept as they are.
attendanceImport.stale: You changed the file or the options after previewing. Preview again before importing.
attendanceImport.invalidRows: {count} row(s) could not be understood and will be ignored:
attendanceImport.skippedManual: {count} record(s) entered by hand will not be replaced (turn the option on above to replace them).
attendanceImport.noRows: Nothing would be recorded with these settings.
attendanceImport.unmatched: {count} person(s) in the file matched no student
attendanceImport.unmatchedHint: No enrolled student has this email or name. They may be a teacher, a guest, or someone who joined with a different email. Record them by hand in the table after importing.
attendanceImport.notInFile: {count} enrolled student(s) are not in the file

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emailBody: We email you lecture reminders, deadlines and important results. Notifications always stay inside the platform too.
notifications.emailLabel: Send important notifications to my email
